questions.explain: good 的 /d/ 和 time 的 /t/ 是相邻爆破音。

questions.stem: 想说乐队正在舞台上表演，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 乐队主动表演，用 is performing。
options: The band is performing on the stage
The band is performed on the stage
The band is perform on the stage
The band is performing in the stage

questions.stem: 想邀请同学去听古典音乐会，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 邀请用 Shall we go。
options: Shall we go to the clasical concert
Shall we go to the classical concert
Shall we going to the classical concert

questions.stem: A student band is performing on the stage. The audience is listening, clapping at the end of each song. The composer of the last piece is a teacher at the school. 谁在舞台上表演？
questions.explain: 短文写 A student band is performing。

questions.stem: A student band is performing on the stage. The audience is listening, clapping at the end of each song. The composer of the last piece is a teacher at the school. 听众在每首歌结束时做什么？
questions.explain: 短文写 clapping。

questions.stem: 要点：学生乐队、周五舞台演出、听众请准时。哪一句三个要点都有？
questions.explain: 三个要点都要出现。
options: The student band is performing on the stage on Friday, and the audience should arrive on time

questions.stem: 通知里用 -ing 作状语描述入场，哪一句正确？
questions.explain: Entering 的逻辑主语应是听话的人。
options: Entered the hall, please keep quiet
The hall entering, please keep quiet
Entering the hall, please keep quiet

questions.stem: 选择表示「表演」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示表演的单词是 perform。

questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「听众」？
questions.explain: audience 的意思是听众。

questions.stem: 选择表示「节奏」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示节奏的单词是 rhythm。

questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「作曲家」？
questions.explain: composer 的意思是作曲家。

questions.stem: 哪一句是正确的？
questions.explain: smiling 作定语修饰 audience，表示面带微笑。
options: The smiled audience loved the song
The smile audience loved the song
The smiling audience loved the song
The audience smiling loved are the song

questions.stem: Her job is ___ the stage. 表示工作是布置舞台，横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: is 后面说明工作内容，用 designing 作表语。

questions.stem: 哪一句是正确的？
questions.explain: listening 的逻辑主语是 He。歌曲不能作 listening 的主语。
options: He sat in the audience, listened carefully
He sat in the audience, listen carefully
Listening carefully, the song was beautiful
He sat in the audience, listening carefully

questions.stem: We watched the band ___. 表示看着乐队演奏，横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: band 主动表演，宾补用 performing。

questions.stem: 哪一个短语最适合练习连读？
questions.explain: stand 以辅音结尾，up 以元音开头。其余相邻处多是辅音接辅音。

questions.stem: 连读主要发生在什么位置？
questions.explain: 连读是把词尾辅音和词首元音连起来。
options: 前一个词的辅音和后一个词的元音之间
两个逗号之间必须停顿

questions.stem: 不完全爆破时，前一个爆破音通常怎样？
questions.explain: 前一个爆破音往往只成阻，不完全释放。
options: 口型做到，但气流不完全冲出

questions.stem: sit down 里更容易出现不完全爆破的是哪一个？
questions.explain: /t/ 后面紧接 down 的 /d/，/t/ 常常不完全爆破。

questions.stem: 想描述听众边听边微笑，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: smiling 作状语，逻辑主语是 audience。

questions.stem: 想说明节奏让演出很兴奋，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 演出的性质用 exciting，不是人的感受 excited。
options: The rhythm made the show excited
Exciting made the rhythm a person
The rhythm made the show exciting

questions.stem: A student band is performing on the stage. The audience is listening, clapping at the end of each song. The composer of the last piece is a teacher at the school. 最后一首曲子的作曲家是谁？
questions.explain: 短文写 a teacher at the school。

questions.stem: A student band is performing on the stage. The audience is listening, clapping at the end of each song. The composer of the last piece is a teacher at the school. 这段文字主要在做什么？
questions.explain: 短文只是在描述表演和听众。

questions.stem: 哪一句适合作为通知标题？
questions.explain: 标题可以写 Student band on stage this Friday。
options: Student band on stage this Friday
Studant band on stage this Friday
Student band on stages this Friday
Student band in stage this Friday

questions.stem: 哪一句的定语是动词 -ing？
questions.explain: performing 作定语，表示正在表演的乐队。
options: The performed band needs two more players
The performing band needs two more players
The band performing needs are players two
